title: Verify Technician cannot approve or authorize a work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Technician role. (Tech View users cannot approve work order lines).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
The work order has a line awaiting approval.
steps:
1. Open the work order and locate the line awaiting approval.
2. Look for an Approve/Authorize action on the line.
expected: The Approve/Authorize action is hidden - the Technician has no way to approve or authorize the line.
